steps.name: Madeline's Troubles (1)
steps.objective: After talking with [Io] in “Gerda,” go to [Madeline] in “Deborah Snowfield.”

lines.text: (Io looks at Gerda’s sky with lonely eyes.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There really isn't much left. How long have we been waiting for this day? .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hey, what's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Io. I just came here. Is there something I shouldn't come to now?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's not true, because it's not the time yet. Anyway, welcome back. Gerda always welcomes visits from %s.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It was thanks to %s that Miss Medea made up her mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What am I? I haven't done much.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There isn't much... . If you go too far with humility, you'll get stabbed in the heart with an icicle. I continued to visit Kali village and listened to people's requests without stopping... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even the goddess is thankful.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: By the way, about Knossos. I guess to some extent, but I still want to hear from you... . Can you tell me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, what happened was… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Io in detail what happened at Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If it's Miss Medea's clan, that witch might also be related.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … I don't know how much I can help... Because that's what Miss Medea has to do...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Ah, I think Madeline is having trouble over there. Would you like to hear it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me? Can I help you?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I think %s's story will be more helpful than mine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If so, I will go.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. See you later then.

steps.name: Madeline's Troubles (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Echo] in the “Fountain of Echoes” and obtain <Eternal Snowflake>. Then report the quest to [Madeline] in “Deborah Snowfield.”

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Uh, what brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s been a while, Madeleine.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: By any chance, Io was talking about me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, what happened?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: It's no big deal.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Phew… . I'll just tell you. I don't think he'll ever go back... .

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: It was hard because his image kept appearing in my dreams.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: This is Landain. Although I was an enemy with Adventurer, I am someone who tries to remember in a different way.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Deborah There is a mysterious flower in the oral tradition handed down in the snowy fields. It is said that if you find that flower and keep it, you can have good dreams.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I don't know if it's true or not, but I'm looking for that flower right now. I looked for all the snowy fields, but there didn't seem to be anything like it.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: But… , I somehow felt like I was in a place I had never been to... .

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I couldn't bear to tell Io. Io, going there again wouldn't be a very good memory... .

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Whoa, I'm telling this story to Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. I'll take a look.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes? excuse me… .

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Then I will ask you a favor. Please find just one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Then I'll be waiting here for you.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes… .

steps.name: Madeline's Troubles (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Echo] in the “Fountain of Echoes” and obtain <Eternal Snowflake>. Then report the quest to [Io] in “Gerda.”

lines.text: (Madeline is looking at the flowers given to her by %s.)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: A little flower inside a piece of ice... . It feels like I'll be inside forever.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe it's because the ice in Deborah's snowfield is special, but it's a bit surprising. I couldn't find it when I went to the Well of Echoes before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What I was able to discover was what was behind it….)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madeline?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I feel better. I don't know if it's because of these flowers, but I feel like something that was depressing inside me flew away. You can have good dreams, right?
(When Madeleine smiles, the ice in her hand suddenly melts.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: The fact that the ice melted like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think it was probably a tool that was meant to melt if it went through any changes...)
(Madeline looks quietly at the flower in her hand.)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: This is Deborah Snowflake. Even in the snow, it blooms with difficulty and shows its beautiful appearance, giving hope and comfort to those who see it.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: The language of flowers is also hope and comfort... . It becomes even more special because it meets Deborah’s special ice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: … Thank you, Adventurer. I'm somewhat better now... , Io, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why Io?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: It's always okay, it should be okay... And only work for the villagers. I hope you take care of yourself too... .

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Could you please save me one more flower?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will find it and give it to Io. I also wanted to give something to Io, and it turned out well.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I'm sorry, and thank you.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Anyway, this flower… . Should I put it in a picture frame or something?
